name: The Soul Jam Revue
aliases: The Soul Jam Revue: A Tribute to Philly Soul

evidence.note: Band site: high-energy soul, funk and R&B show that makes you want to dance and sing along.
CM Performing Arts Center page: Philly soul tribute, Sunday Oct 4 at 7 pm.

dancing.notes: The band plays upbeat soul and funk meant to get people dancing, but the Oct 4 show is a seated theater concert, so expect mostly listening with some dancing.

description: Long Island soul and funk revue paying tribute to the 1970s Sound of Philadelphia (The O'Jays, The Spinners, Teddy Pendergrass) plus Earth, Wind & Fire and Kool & the Gang.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Theater setting this weekend; the band also plays outdoor concerts and festivals where dancing is more likely.
